purpose: Source map for future human and AI investigations. Preserve working links and the relevant source passage or artifact when it is useful and permissible. Do not confuse a reference with proof of an organizational outcome.

sources.relevance: Founder's actual statements; source for proposed culture and mechanisms.
Question landscapes, competing explanations, empirical investigations and sufficient stopping points.
Work backward from goals, reuse working mechanisms, compare practical alternatives.
Possibility landscapes, practical competence, communities, resources and accumulated knowledge.
Knowing of a possibility versus understanding, using or composing it.
Exposure to diverse actual project attempts, mechanisms and failures.
Example of accessible practical experiments without a fully equipped physical laboratory.
Potential transferable experience in youth organization, funding and community engagement; not the same organization.

future_source_families.collect: Primary accounts, operating models, actual participation, budgets and failures.
Annual reports, public filings, grants, leases and real cost inputs when available.
Public-safe interviews, event notes, project outcomes, what changed and why.
Speaker guides, safety resources, facility arrangements, public policies and real opportunity sources.

recording_principle: Use lightweight source IDs and dated records where they help future retrieval. Keep enough context to distinguish aspirations, proposals, evidence and decisions. Avoid raw private data or indiscriminate collection.
